meta.name: heygen
meta.description: HeyGen avatar videos, photo animation, lipsync, video translation, TTS and voice cloning via inference.sh CLI. Apps: heygen/avatar-video (Avatar IV/V engines, up to 4K), heygen/create-avatar (digital twin, photo or prompt avatars), heygen/photo-video, heygen/lipsync, heygen/video-agent (prompt to finished video), heygen/video-translate (30+ languages with voice cloning and lip-sync), heygen/text-to-speech (Starfish), heygen/voice-clone (instant clone). Use for: AI presenters, digital twins, talking photos, dubbing and localizing videos, re-syncing lips to new audio, custom voices, prompt-to-video explainers. Triggers: heygen, heygen avatar, heygen api, digital twin, avatar iv, avatar v, photo avatar, talking photo, video translate, video translation, translate video, dub video, heygen lipsync, lip sync, heygen tts, starfish tts, voice clone, instant voice clone, video agent, ai spokesperson, ai presenter
